_doc: Translation chunks for the English overlay. A key belongs to the chunk with the LONGEST matching prefix; keys that match no prefix go to 'default'. Its English goes in tools/lang/en/<id>.json. List a chunk's Dutch: python tools/lang/check_en.py --dump <id> (or --todo <id> for the untranslated ones). Translate c01_names first: it fixes the item/block/creature names the other chunks use (together with tools/lang/GLOSSARY.md).
